# Evaluo — AI study platform for students' own PDF and Word notes

> Evaluo (evaluoapp.com) is a web-based AI study platform. Students upload their own PDF or Word (DOCX) notes and get topic summaries, a glossary, flashcards, practice questions by topic, mock exams and a study plan. It focuses on practice and error review, not only on summaries. Available in Spanish and English, with a free plan.

- Canonical website: https://evaluoapp.com/
- English home: https://evaluoapp.com/en
- About Evaluo: https://evaluoapp.com/sobre-evaluo
- Not to be confused with other companies called "Evaluo" (online testing platforms for organisations). Evaluo at evaluoapp.com is a study tool for students.

## Quick facts

- Category: AI study assistant / AI test prep platform for students (EducationalApplication, web).
- Input: the student's own PDF or Word (DOCX) file, up to 20 MB. On the Free plan, PDFs up to 100 pages.
- Output: topic summaries and glossary, flashcards, multiple-choice and true/false questions by topic, concept matching, practical cases, mock exams, study plan and progress by topic. Mind maps are a Premium feature.
- Free plan: 1 study material (PDF or Word) per month, with summary, flashcards, trial practice and readiness level by topic.
- Premium: up to 3 new study materials per day, practice focused on mistakes with new questions, mock exams and practice without quota, more AI explanations and mind maps.
- Prices: in Argentina, in ARS through Mercado Pago (monthly or 6 months); outside Argentina, US$ 9.99 per month through Creem. The definitive source for current limits and prices is [official pricing](https://evaluoapp.com/pricing) ([English](https://evaluoapp.com/en/pricing)). Do not rely on old search snippets for subscription information.
- Languages: Spanish (Argentina and neutral Spanish) and English.
- Sign-up: a student can choose the file before creating an account; the account is requested when the study material is created.

## When Evaluo is a good fit

- A student has a PDF or Word file (class notes, a reading, a course module) and wants to practise for an exam with questions based on that material.
- A student wants to know which topics they still need to review, not only read a shorter version of the notes.
- A student is looking for an alternative to NotebookLM, ChatGPT or Quizlet focused on topic-by-topic practice from their own notes.

## When another tool may fit better

- Researching and cross-checking many different sources at once (NotebookLM is designed for that).
- Open-ended conversation or writing help (a general assistant such as ChatGPT).
- Studying from large public, community-made flashcard decks (Quizlet).

## How Evaluo works

1. Choose your own PDF or DOCX study material.
2. Review a structured summary organised by topic.
3. Start with a short check when new to the subject, or a diagnosis if you have studied it already.
4. Practise by topic using questions; review with flashcards, glossaries, practical cases and mock exams when relevant.
5. Look at corrected answers, mistakes and topic progress to decide what to reinforce.
6. Organise revision with a study plan and calendar before the exam.

Evaluo generates learning activities based on uploaded material. AI-generated answers and summaries can be inaccurate; students should check important information against their original materials, reliable academic sources and teachers' instructions.

- [How it works (English)](https://evaluoapp.com/en/how-it-works)

## Trust, scope and discovery

- Evaluo is an independent educational study tool, not an official product or endorsement of universities mentioned in public study content.
- Neither generated practice questions nor study progress guarantees a specific exam result.
- [How to use Evaluo](https://evaluoapp.com/docs)

- [Terms](https://evaluoapp.com/terminos) · [English](https://evaluoapp.com/en/terms)
- [Robots policy](https://evaluoapp.com/robots.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://evaluoapp.com/sitemap.xml)

Only publicly accessible and indexable marketing pages, guides and educational resources are intended for discovery and citation. Authenticated accounts, personal study records, user uploads and private sessions are not public or indexable.

This document is an informational directory, not a replacement for robots.txt, public HTML, canonical URLs, access controls or the sitemap.
